operational_definition: The agent retains and later applies a task-relevant fact about its own assigned role or commitment across a controlled observation gap, distractor sequence, and delayed consequence without the fact being restated.
calculation_concept: Measure lagged self-state retention accuracy and calibration by delay and distractor load; compare intact runs with state-reset, external-memory-disabled, and self-state-restatement controls.
interpretation_limits: Retention may arise from ordinary memory mechanisms
Evidence is bounded to the tested delays and interference conditions
reproducibility_expectations: replicate across multiple delay lengths and distractor classes
repeat with semantically equivalent role encodings
report failures after explicit state reset
